sections.heading: UEM Jaipur vs Vivekananda Global University for Healthcare - PG: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose UEM Jaipur if you want a recorded fee of ₹70,000, in a private Healthcare - PG setting at Jaipur.
Choose Vivekananda Global University if you want a recorded fee of ₹1 lakh, in a private Healthcare - PG setting at Jaipur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹70,000 as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga Education at UEM Jaipur. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹1 lakh as a tuition figure for Master of Occupational Therapy Neuro science at Vivekananda Global University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for UEM Jaipur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Vivekananda Global University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether UEM Jaipur's recorded ₹70,000 or Vivekananda Global University's ₹1 lakh fits your budget for this Healthcare - PG.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, UEM Jaipur or Vivekananda Global University?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. UEM Jaipur and Vivekananda Global University differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of Healthcare - PG classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for UEM Jaipur vs Vivekananda Global University?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹70,000 for UEM Jaipur on Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga Education; our records list ₹1 lakh for Vivekananda Global University on Master of Occupational Therapy Neuro science. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for UEM Jaipur and Vivekananda Global University?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for UEM Jaipur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do UEM Jaipur and Vivekananda Global University accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for UEM Jaipur, and no listed exam on this page for Vivekananda Global University. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are UEM Jaipur and Vivekananda Global University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
